description: This file defines the BasketWithItemsSpecification class, which specifies the criteria for querying Basket entities with their associated items, based on either basket ID or buyer ID.

classes.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification
classes.description: A specification class for retrieving Basket entities along with their items, filtered by basket ID or buyer ID.

methods.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification(int basketId)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a specification to find a basket by its ID, including its items.

methods.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification(string buyerId)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a specification to find a basket by buyer ID, including its items.
